title: Boku no Hero Academia: I Am a Hero Too
content:
What a weird goodbye episode this was. Unfortunately, there is nothing about this that speaks to me, more like a bad timing episode if you asked me.

There is nothing that this does that the My Hero Academia: More doesn’t. But it doesn’t hurt it much seeing as that is a parent story for this one. Also, let’s not stress that the episode was only 6 minutes long. I’m not the biggest Eri fan so it felt like a steal for me that the latest MhA episode I’d watch would be about something I’m very uninterested in. But good thing we get to see old All Might still hanging around.

Overall: 6.5/10.
